message:
🎄✨ Kettering & Corby Volunteer Befriender Christmas Party ✨🎄
What a fantastic day spent celebrating with our amazing Volunteer Befrienders hosted at Housing 21, Sir John Brown Court in Kettering. We enjoyed plenty of conversation and festive carol singing, accompanied by our very own volunteer Mike playing the organ. 💛
Your kindness, companionship, and dedication make such a difference to the people we support at SERVE, today and every day.
A massive thank you to the amazing local businesses who generously donated all the buffet food for our celebration. Your support helps us bring our community together in the most meaningful way.

Rios Peri Peri Kettering

Here’s to our fantastic Befrienders and the brilliant work you do throughout the year. We appreciate you more than words can say! 🌟❤️
